purpose: Track the smallest real-weight llama.cpp-vs-Go comparison until prompt templating and denoising/sampler semantics are aligned.
llamacpp_decoded_response_contains: Hello! How can I help you today?
known_differences: llama.cpp -p hi applies its DiffusionGemma chat/template path and emits a thought/channel response; the Go comparison run used raw -prompt tokenization and generated a single '.' token.
llama.cpp entropy-bound generation reported 11 denoise steps for --diffusion-steps 1, while Go currently interprets -denoise-steps 1 as one denoiser iteration.
The local llama.cpp build does not include llama-tokenize, so exact llama.cpp prompt IDs for the templated prompt have not yet been captured.
next_required_action: Capture exact llama.cpp templated prompt IDs and match entropy-bound denoising/sampler semantics before treating this as a pass/fail parity fixture.
